propositions: BindingStore module (799 lines) couples byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and peer-state delegation with no cohesive ownership, blocking safe mutation and requiring extraction behind a preserved public facade
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, creating safety hazards that force decomposition into separate repository, lifecycle, and recovery owners

Journal-free retirement must enforce a durable-tombstone completion rule where a retired binding is removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree, and only explicit unretire revokes intent

Incomplete-operation recovery must run after staleness validation but before remote issue observation, executing exact-match interrupted-retirement completion idempotently without new liveness evidence interleaving

Three-slice extraction (repository persistence, lifecycle policy, narrow mutation seam) must preserve all unknown fields, JSON formatting, comment identity, selective-publication ordering, and existing five-file atomic replacement without format migration or deep-copy changes to all_bindings()
